{{Use Canadian English|date=August 2026}}
 
'''Kevin Sands''' is a Canadian children's author from Ontario.<ref>{{Cite web |last=van Koeverden |first=Jane |date=2018-10-17 |title=Bestselling YA writer Kevin Sands reveals the toughest literary rejection he ever received |url=https://www.cbc.ca/books/bestselling-ya-writer-kevin-sands-reveals-the-toughest-literary-rejection-he-ever-received-1.4833700 |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=[[CBC Books]]}}</ref> 

Sands began his career teaching math and physics to high school students.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Maughan |first=Shannon |date=2015-12-11 |title=Fall 2015 Flying Starts: Kevin Sands |url=https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/by-topic/childrens/childrens-authors/article/68934-fall-2015-flying-starts-kevin-sands.html |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=[[Publishers Weekly]] |language=en |archive-date=May 20, 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240520153958/https://www.publishersweekly.com/pw/by-topic/childrens/childrens-authors/article/68934-fall-2015-flying-starts-kevin-sands.html |url-status=live }}</ref> He published his debut novel, ''[[The Blackthorn Key]]'', with [[Simon & Schuster]] in 2015.<ref>*{{Cite web |last=Whitlock |first=Nathan |date=2015-10-14 |title=The Blackthorn Key |url=https://quillandquire.com/review/the-blackthorn-key/ |access-date=2026-01-02 |website=[[Quill and Quire]] |language=en }}
*{{Cite web |last=Eisenhart |first=Mary |title=The Blackthorn Key, Book 1 Book Review |url=https://www.commonsensemedia.org/book-reviews/the-blackthorn-key-book-1 |access-date=2026-01-02 |website=[[Common Sense Media]] |language=en |archive-date=October 23, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231023154721/http://www.commonsensemedia.org/book-reviews/the-blackthorn-key-book-1 |url-status=live }}
*{{Cite web |date=2015-06-29 |title=The Blackthorn Key by Kevin Sands |url=https://www.publishersweekly.com/9781481446518 |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=[[Publishers Weekly]] }}

*{{Cite web |last=Cooke |first=Ariel Zeitlin |date=2016-09-29 |title=Mark of the Plague |url=https://www.booklistonline.com/products/8291011 |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=[[Booklist]] }}</ref> ''The Assassin's Curse'' (2017),<ref>{{Cite web |last=Eisenhart |first=Mary |title=The Assassin's Curse: Blackthorn Key, Book 3 |url=https://www.commonsensemedia.org/book-reviews/the-assassins-curse-blackthorn-key-book-3 |access-date=2026-08-31 |website=[[Common Sense Media]] |language=en |archive-date=June 9, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230609013206/https://www.commonsensemedia.org/book-reviews/the-assassins-curse-blackthorn-key-book-3 |url-status=live }}</ref> ''Call of the Wraith'' (2018),<ref>{{Cite web|date=2018-08-21|title=Call of the Wraith|url=https://www.cbc.ca/books/call-of-the-wraith-1.4793507|access-date=2026-01-02|website=[[CBC Books]]|archive-date=April 9, 2025|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250409150904/https://www.cbc.ca/books/call-of-the-wraith-1.4793507|url-status=live}}</ref> ''The Traitor's Blade'' (2022), and ''The Raven's Revenge'' (2024).<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-05-19 |title=The Raven's Revenge by Kevin Sands |url=https://www.cbc.ca/books/the-raven-s-revenge-by-kevin-sands-1.6846284 |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=[[CBC Books]] |archive-date=May 26, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230526152716/http://www.cbc.ca/books/the-raven-s-revenge-by-kevin-sands-1.6846284 |url-status=live }}</ref> This book series takes place in 17th-century England/Europe. The main character is Christopher Rowe, and his friends are Tom Bailey and Sally Deschamps. Together, they solve mysteries and stop malicious plots against their king, [[Charles II of England|King Charles II]]. 

Following ''The Blackthorn Key'' series, Sands began the ''Thieves of Shadow'' series, including ''Children of the Fox'' (2021),<ref>*{{Cite web |last=Grange |first=Heidi |date=2021-11-01 |title=Children of the Fox |url=https://www.slj.com/review/children-of-the-fox |access-date=2026-08-30 |website=[[School Library Journal]] }}
